Name: Earthy Downtown Zuzu
Author: PixieTJ
Description:
After creating my recolor for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30537]Vibrant Pastoral Zuzu[/url], I got quite a few requests do also do an earthy recolor. So here it is! I used my VBR Zuzu recolor as a base, since the desaturated tones worked well with Earthy, to fill in gaps that Earthy Recolor and Earthy Interiors don't cover.

I got a bit too enamored with how DaisyNiko recolored the Joja vending machines, and I will run a theme into the GROUND. So.. uhh.. Joja has a new color scheme, at least for Zuzu city? Sorry not sorry.

I was as thorough as I could and did a fair bit of my own twist to it too. I hope you enjoy!

Unfortunately, the only way to install is via overwriting Zuzu assets. There's no way to do this via content patcher (At least not that I've been able to figure out)

[b]Note! The only hard requirement is Downtown Zuzu. Everything is recommended, but it's just for cohesiveness.
[/b]
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/XxHarvzBackxX?gameId=1303]XxHarvzBackxX[/url] for Downtown Zuzu and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DaisyNiko?gameId=1303]DaisyNiko[/url] for Earthy Recolor and Earthy Interiors. Also thanks to Vibrant Pastoral which some of this uses (Mostly mines).
